used.text: Explanation of ara::com API AUTOSAR AP R25-11 ara::com expects proxy related artifacts inside a namespace "proxy". This name- space is typically included in a namespace hierarchy deduced from the service defini- tion and its context. 5.3.1 Proxy Class API’s • FindService() • StartFindService() • StopFindService() • Subscribe() • Unsubscribe() • GetSubscriptionState() • SetSubscriptionStateChangeHandler() • UnsetSubscriptionStateChangeHandler() • GetNewSamples() • GetFreeSampleCount() • SetReceiveHandler() • UnsetReceiveHandler() • ResolveInstanceIDs() • Field::Get() • Field::Set() 5.3.2 RadarService Proxy Class Example

Specification of Communication Management AUTOSAR AP R25-11 [SWS_CM_00823] Default value of Minimum Send Interval and disabling Mini- mum Send Interval monitoring for Methods ⌈ If the configured Minimum Send Inter- val ( ServiceInterfaceDeploymentElement . minimumSendInterval ) of a Re- quest&Response or Fire&Forget method has the value 0, the Minimum Send Inter- val monitoring shall not be active for the method and its corresponding operator () , i.e., ara::com will not limit the Tx frequency by dropping method calls by the client. For each Field of a ServiceInterfaceDeployment , 0 shall be the de- fault value for the corresponding ServiceInterfaceDeploymentElement . mini- mumSendInterval . This means that unless ServiceInterfaceDeploymentEle- ment . minimumSendInterval for a given method is explicitly configured to be > 0, the Tx rate is not limited by ara::com . ⌋ 7.5.20 Update notification events for fields [SWS_CM_00120] Provision of an update notification event for a Field Upstream requirements: RS_CM_00218 ⌈ If hasNotifier is true, update notification events for the Field shall be provided as of the following requirements: • [SWS_CM_00141] Method to subscribe to a service event. This subscribe leads immediately to a service event that contains the initial field value send from provider side to the consumer. • [SWS_CM_00151] Method to unsubscribe from a service event. • [SWS_CM_00316] Method to query the subscription state. • [SWS_CM_00701] Method to receive a service event using polling. • [SWS_CM_00181] Method to enable service event trigger. • [SWS_CM_00182] Event Receive Handler call serialization. • [SWS_CM_00183] Method to disable service event trigger. • [SWS_CM_00333] Method to set a subscription state change handler. • [SWS_CM_00334] Method to unset a subscription state change handler. Except that the corresponding methods reside in the Field class instead of the Event class. ⌋ [SWS_CM_00143] Minimum Send Interval monitoring for transmission requests for Fields ⌈ To protect receivers from flooding/overload, each field shall have a config- urable Minimum Send Interval (see ServiceInterfaceDeploymentElement . min- imumSendInterval ), which specifies the minimum amount of time that shall pass be- tween two consecutive transmissions, i.e., the Minimum Send Interval limits the max- imum Tx frequency of a given field in the network.
